_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. Release: December 10, 2020 on PC, PS4, Xbox One and Stadia (CD Projekt Red); PS5/Xbox Series X|S versions February 2022, Switch 2 in 2025. The Phantom Liberty expansion (PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S) came out September 26, 2023 (announced at the June 2023 Xbox Games Showcase; GameSpot, VGC, cyberpunk.net), and is covered in this same file. Names from the main story and Phantom Liberty as covered by Wikipedia and the Cyberpunk wiki: Johnny Silverhand, Jackie Welles, Judy Alvarez, Panam Palmer, Kerry Eurodyne, River Ward, Goro Takemura, Evelyn Parker, Dexter DeShawn, the Arasaka family, Alt Cunningham, Rogue, Adam Smasher, Mikoshi, the Relic; Phantom Liberty's Solomon Reed, Songbird (Song So Mi), President Rosalind Myers, Kurt Hansen and Dogtown. Voice/likeness cast: Keanu Reeves (Johnny), Idris Elba (Reed), Cherami Leigh and Gavin Drea (V). The main character V is left out (too short); Valerie and Vincent are too common to be worth it. Weak words: Jackie, Judy, Kerry, River, Evelyn, Dex, Rogue, Viktor, Misty, Reed, Myers, Songbird, Smasher, Relic, Afterlife, Maelstrom, Night City, Dogtown, Cyberpunk (a genre word) and Blackwall are first names, surnames or ordinary words. All actors are weak (Keanu Reeves and Idris Elba appear in many films). Overlap: Arasaka, Militech, Adam Smasher, Night City and Maelstrom also appear in the anime Cyberpunk: Edgerunners (not used as a context word on purpose) and the tabletop game, and will appear in the announced sequel; posts about those may be covered. Panam, Takemura and Silverhand are distinctive and stay strong. Accounts: @CyberpunkGame (official game account). @CDPROJEKTRED is left out: it posts mostly about The Witcher. Handle taken from the official site and widespread coverage; verified status not checked live. Trimmed 2026-11-19 by the main session: removed very common first names, real cities, Marvel/mythology overlaps and famous actors (River, Rogue, Reed, Myers, Misty, Evelyn, Dex, Relic, Afterlife, Maelstrom, Keanu Reeves, Idris Elba), and generic backup words, so ordinary posts are not covered.
